walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 02: Externally Set Task — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 02: Externally Set Task brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 02: Externally Set Task.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the rule of thirds?
options: A guideline placing key elements along lines or intersections of a 3x3 grid.
Relief is for paper, intaglio is for fabric.
Using exactly three colours.
A strict mathematical rule that must never be broken.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between relief and intaglio printing?
options: Relief prints from raised surfaces; intaglio prints from incised lines below the surface.
Relief is for paper, intaglio is for fabric.
Just measurements.
They are different names for the same process.

mcqs.q: What can line in a composition imply, even without representing an object?
options: Movement, direction, emotion, and visual rhythm.
Only the outline of an object.
Just measurements.
Relief is for paper, intaglio is for fabric.
